name: duopore-public-education-budget
description: See whether your study funds cover the costs you expect each month.

interface.longDescription: See whether your study funds cover the costs you expect each month. Enter tuition and other costs, available funds and the time you plan to study. View a month-by-month budget and spot months where money may run short. Use one currency. For adults planning their own studies. Missing costs are not guessed, and the result is not financial advice.
defaultPrompt: Build a monthly study budget from these costs and funds.
Which months may have a shortfall in my education budget?
